subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SJR11
title: Proposes an amendment to the Oregon Constitution to require a certain percentage of lottery revenues to be expended for wildfire prevention, suppression or management. Refers the proposed amendment to the people for their approval or rejection at the next regular general election.
headline: SJR 11 did not pass

claims.text: SJR 11 was introduced in the Senate on January 13, 2025.
SJR 11 was still in a Senate committee when the session ended. Last recorded step: June 27, 2025.
Each of the 4 recorded steps was checked against Oregon's chamber procedure and every move was a legal one.
SJR 11 is a proposed change to the Oregon Constitution. It would have gone to voters if passed; it did not pass, so it will not be on your ballot.

timeline.text: Public hearing held in a Senate committee
